name: read_file
description: Reads a file by path and returns its text. Address it by line with start_line and line_count (the result reports start_line, end_line, the file's total lines, and next_line), or by byte with offset and limit. Either way whole lines are returned, never a fragment, and a short result reports where to resume. Pass hashes: true to prefix every line with `{line:04} {xxhash16:4}  ` so a later edit_file hashline op can target those lines. Prefer this over repo_search when you need a file's exact contents (e.g. src/agent/loop.zig, AGENTS.md, manifests).
llm_description: Read a file's text, by line (start_line/line_count) or by byte (offset/limit); reports where to resume. hashes:true prefixes each line with a 4-hex xxHash so edit_file op=hashline can patch without reproducing the text. Prefer over repo_search for exact contents.

path.description: Path of the file to read, relative to the sandbox root (e.g. "src/agent/loop.zig").

offset.description: Byte offset to resume from, for walking a file whose lines you do not know. Ignored when start_line is given.

limit.description: Maximum bytes to return, snapped down to a line boundary (default 768 KiB).

start_line.description: First line to return, 1-based. Use this when a diagnostic or search result gave you a line number; it is what file:line references mean.

line_count.description: How many lines to return from start_line (default 200).

hashes.description: Prefix every returned line with `{line:04} {hash:4}  ` (xxHash32 lower 16 bits of the line, no newline). Use with edit_file op=hashline.
